description: old man seer, a poet prophet, a long white beard and long white hair, the nose, cheeks and mouth clearly visible, the beard starting below the mouth, standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet and the whole weapon inside the image, about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, legendary and majestic, far more powerful and richly equipped than an ordinary hero, a godlike ultimate form, grander and more radiant than any legendary hero, a laurel wreath of silver leaves, a long deep blue robe embroidered with silver stars and a golden open eye on the chest, a long cloak like the night sky with tiny shining stars, a thick book of prophecies chained at the belt, holding a tall staff topped with a glowing crystal ball in which faint visions swirl, the whole staff inside the image, wise and solemn, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same man: the same face, hair and build, drawn the same way; now in a far grander, godlike outfit and weapon of the same kind, not this outfit
